pages.title: Choosing Seats
pages.text: A common method: take one wind tile each of East, South, West and North, shuffle them face down and let everyone draw. East picks a seat first, then South, West and North.$(br2)Some tables include the 1-pin and 2-pin tiles, or roll dice to decide the draw order before seating by the drawn wind.

pages.title: First Dealer
pages.text: The player in the East seat rolls two dice; counting counter-clockwise from that player, the indicated player becomes the $(thing)temporary dealer$(0). That player rolls again, and the player indicated this time is the dealer of the first hand.$(br2)Simpler rules let the East seat deal, or decide with a single roll.
